route: No independent-means route for non-EEA nationals. UDI's 'Want to apply' menu lists family immigration, EU/EEA, work, visits (up to 90 days), study, protection, permanent residence, citizenship and a few special cases; nothing for retirees or people with own means. UDI's own-funds page applies only to EU/EEA nationals: 'health insurance or, if you are retired, you must document that you are entitled to healthcare'.
policy: A lawfully resident non-EEA pensioner becomes a National Insurance member and is covered by the public service with user fees. For the couple 0 premium; the ceiling on patient fees (exemption card) is NOK 3,278 per person in 2026. Private cover is not required.
working: Premium 0. Patient fees capped at NOK 3,278 per person a year = NOK 6,556 for two = NOK 546.33 a month at most (6,556 / 12), only if they use enough care.

income_based_charges.name: Trygdeavgift (National Insurance contribution)
income_based_charges.rate: 7.6% on salary; 5.1% on pensions; 10.8% other business income
income_based_charges.includes_capital_gains: unclear: the page lists wage, business and pension income only; not checked whether investment withdrawals count
income_based_charges.ceiling: never more than 25% of the personal income above NOK 99,650

eu_citizen_difference: EU/EEA pensioners need an S1 from the paying state; own-funds EU/EEA citizens need private insurance covering all illness costs and are not entitled to free care.
spot_check: None: no private premium is needed or sought.
uncertainty: No route exists, so this models a hypothetical resident. Whether ETF withdrawals attract trygdeavgift is unchecked and goes to the tax agent. The skatteetaten page year label was not captured. Non-working residents may not become members if the stay is under 12 months (not sourced).

statutory_must_pay.what: National Insurance membership has no fixed premium; the trygdeavgift is income-based (tax code).

private_plan.terms: Specialist consultation within 7 working days, treatment or surgery within 10, imaging, private hospital treatment when the public cannot treat within the guarantee, physiotherapy, psychology up to 10 sessions. No deductible (egenandel 0).
private_plan.pricing: If's price table lists 4,304 NOK for age 45 without stating the period; read as a year because bytt.no says a standard health insurance costs 3,000-8,000 NOK a year. 2 x 4,304 / 12 = 717.33 a month. If it were monthly, the figure would be twelve times higher; unlikely for the product.
